must.title: Dune
must.reason: Direct first half of the same story.

can.title: Pineapple Express
can.reason: A running thread of the film's jokes — including a fake sequel pitch — assumes you've seen it.

can.title: Superbad
can.reason: The cast play exaggerated versions of the personas they built here.

must.title: Captain America: Civil War
must.reason: Civil War fractures the Avengers and scatters them as fugitives — Infinity War assumes you know why Cap, Widow and Falcon are on the run and why Tony won't speak to them.

must.title: Thor: Ragnarok
must.reason: Asgard is destroyed and its survivors are refugees in space when Infinity War opens — that's where Ragnarok left them, along with Loki holding the Tesseract and Hulk refusing to resurface as Banner.

must.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
must.reason: The Quantum Realm mechanics that make Endgame's time-travel plan possible — and how Scott Lang ends up trapped there during the five-year gap — are set up here.

from.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

must.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
must.reason: The multiverse-fracturing spell Doctor Strange casts — and the price he's already paid for meddling with reality — is the direct fallout of No Way Home.

can.title: Dawn of the Dead
can.reason: A deliberate homage to Romero's zombie-siege structure — the pub standoff mirrors the mall siege beat for beat, right down to specific shots.

can.title: The Shining
can.reason: An entire extended sequence recreates the Overlook Hotel in exacting detail — the twins, the elevator, the hedge maze — and lands harder if you recognise it shot for shot.

can.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
can.reason: The opening sequence is a direct parody of 2001's 'Dawn of Man' — same framing, same music cue, same beat where a tool gets flung into the air.

can.title: Point Break
can.reason: The characters watch and explicitly discuss this film on-screen, and the plot's late turn deliberately mirrors its beats.

can.title: Bad Boys II
can.reason: Referenced by name in dialogue as the model for the film's own over-the-top action-movie climax.
